issues.description: manifest.yaml uses 'software: jhead' as the top-level package name field, but code style rule 14 specifies the field should be 'name:'. The expected format per rule 14 is 'name: zlib', not 'software: zlib'.
issues.fix_suggestion: Change 'software: jhead' to 'name: jhead' at line 1 to match the code style rule 14 manifest.yaml format.

issues.description: Duplicate 'guard' key in the 'patch_classification' section. Lines 101 and 102 both contain 'guard: \'pending\'', which is a duplicate YAML mapping key violation. Strict YAML parsers will reject this; permissive parsers silently use the last value. This makes the file technically invalid YAML.
issues.fix_suggestion: Remove the duplicate 'guard: \'pending\'' line (line 102), keeping only one guard key in the patch_classification entry.

issues.description: Stray text 'ilt' on line 90, appearing after the final status line '**最终状态**: built'. This appears to be a fragment accidentally left from the word 'built'. It is invalid content that should not be in the notes file.
issues.fix_suggestion: Delete the stray 'ilt' line at the end of notes.md. The file should end with the '**最终状态**: built' line.

issues.description: Shell script uses '#!/bin/sh' as the shebang, but code style rule 6 specifies scripts should use '#!/usr/bin/zsh'. Using /bin/sh also prevents the use of 'set -o pipefail' which is a bash/zsh feature not available in POSIX sh.
issues.fix_suggestion: Change the shebang to '#!/usr/bin/zsh' to comply with code style rule 6 and enable the full 'set -euo pipefail' safety mode.

issues.description: Shell script uses only 'set -e' but code style rule 7 requires 'set -euo pipefail' as the safety mode. Missing 'set -u' (undefined variable detection) and 'set -o pipefail' (pipe failure propagation).
issues.fix_suggestion: Change 'set -e' to 'set -euo pipefail' and update the shebang to '#!/usr/bin/zsh' since pipefail is not available in POSIX sh.

issues.description: Shell script uses 'PASS:' and 'FAIL:' as output markers (lines 17, 20, 30, 33), but code style rule 9 specifies success should use '[ok]' and failure should use '[fail]'. The markers should also be indented with 8 spaces before '[ok]'/[fail]' when used as step sub-output.
issues.fix_suggestion: Replace 'echo "PASS: version check"' with 'echo "        [ok] version check"' and 'echo "FAIL: version mismatch"' with 'echo "        [fail] version mismatch"'. Apply similarly to lines 30 and 33.

issues.description: The '|| true' on line 26 (output=$("$JHEAD" -h 2>&1 || true)) suppresses errors without an explanatory comment. Code style rule 10 prohibits '|| true' to silently swallow errors unless there is an explicit comment explaining why the error is being ignored. In this case, jhead -h likely returns a non-zero exit code (common for help/usage flags), but no comment explains this.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add an inline comment explaining why the error is suppressed, e.g.: 'output=$("$JHEAD" -h 2>&1 || true)  # jhead -h may exit non-zero (usage flag)'

issues.description: The test_package/conanfile.py test() method only runs 'jhead -V' (version check) directly. The more thorough test_jhead.sh script (which tests both version output and help output with content verification) exists in the test_package directory but is not invoked from the Conan test method. The MANIFEST.yml declares test_jhead.sh as a test_package test with assertion_count: 2, but only 1 assertion is actually exercised by the Conan test.
issues.fix_suggestion: Consider invoking test_jhead.sh from the test() method to exercise both version and help output checks, e.g.: self.run(f'sh "{test_dir}/test_jhead.sh" "{jhead_bin}"', env="conanrun"). Alternatively, add a second self.run() call for 'jhead -h' to increase test coverage.
